workItem: 77.44.7.A — CSS #RGBA parity in Brand Kit color tokens
finding: The Inspector accepted standard four-digit alpha HEX after the prior fix, but the site-wide Brand Kit token normalizer still rejected it.
change: Align the Brand Kit color token contract with the Inspector and CSS by accepting exactly 3, 4, 6 or 8 HEX digits; keep all existing malformed-value rejection.

openSourceReview.license: Apache-2.0; reviewed, no source copied and no dependency added
openSourceReview.fit: Its color transform handles CSS alpha HEX and browser-compatible alpha serialization. Creator Platform stores CSS strings directly rather than converting token color spaces, so its existing strict validator is the appropriate integration point; the full transformer and parser dependencies are unnecessary.
